analysis.title: Market Monitor, Week Ending October 30, 2026
key_insights: The FOMC held the fed funds target range at 3.75-4.00% in October with two dissents in favor of a 25bp hike. The statement said inflation 'remains elevated' and upgraded activity to 'expanding at a strong pace' from 'solid'.

GSAM expects S&P 500 EPS growth to slow from 36% in 2026 to 11% in both 2027 and 2028 as the AI capex impact on earnings moderates. Roughly 40-60% of total bull-market return has historically come after peak earnings growth, so GSAM recommends staying invested and diversifying rather than timing the top.
US Treasury yields fell to seven-week lows on the Fed hold and safe-haven demand tied to concerns about the AI trade. The 2-year ended at 4.59% and the 10-year at 4.93%.

Oil rose on the week with large intra-week swings. Prices jumped Friday after Houthi strikes on Saudi energy facilities, a tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz, and worries about renewed US strikes on Iran after the midterms. WTI ended at $104.12 and Brent at $117.64.
Gold fell to $3,874.62 as higher oil and expectations of a December Fed hike reduced its appeal as a non-yielding asset.

US equities ended the week lower (S&P 500 -0.56%, Nasdaq Composite -1.99%) after Anthropic's IPO filing lifted tech early in the week and weak results from tech giants weighed later. The S&P 500 Equal Weight index rose 0.82%.
US Q3 GDP grew 3.4% annualized above consensus, with consumer spending up 3.8%, also above expectations.

Lula's unexpected win in Brazil's presidential election triggered a selloff in the real and local bonds on October 26. Brazilian 10-year yields peaked at 15.58% and have since eased to 15.23%. External sovereign spreads widened 25bp and corporate credit spreads 5-10bp.

Brazil focus is on the Finance Minister appointment and a credible fiscal correction. Debt-to-GDP is above 90% and the budget deficit is nearly 10% of GDP. Markets price about three 25bp BCB hikes over six months.

GSAM expects higher fiscal premium and a weaker currency to keep Brazilian local rates higher for longer. It says the BCB may not be able to tighten as much as markets price given a weak economy. In credit it favors higher-quality investment-grade issuers and USD-revenue exporters.

In Brazil equities GSAM favors exporters, companies with solid balance sheets and dividend payers over broad macro calls, and says high household indebtedness could pressure consumers and parts of the banking system.
Meta delivered strong results with record engagement and rapid adoption of its AI agent Muse, which passed 10M users within six weeks of launch. High inference costs have delayed a global rollout.

The ECB held at 2.5% and said energy prices pose upside inflation risk and downside growth risk. Lagarde announced she will step down in February. The BoJ held at 1.25% and said its 2% underlying inflation target has been met for the first time since 2013.
Sector returns show energy leading and communication services and info tech lagging both month-to-date and year-to-date in the S&P 500 and MSCI World.
MSCI Brazil fell 17.32% on the week. Bitcoin fell 5.48% on the week and is down 12.20% year-to-date. US HY spreads widened to 340bp from 311bp at end of September.

sector_views.rationale: Favors stock selection over broad macro calls, with exporters, strong balance sheets and dividend payers preferred. Higher rates and fiscal worries may suppress valuations near term.
Ad spending shifts to platforms that show results and use AI to automate advertising, while traditional media agencies face pressure.

earnings_insights: Meta reported strong results (report does not give figures), with record engagement and rapid adoption of its Muse AI agent. Commerce is seen as a potential monetization path.
S&P 500 EPS growth forecast by GSAM: 36% in 2026, 11% in 2027 and 11% in 2028.
Weak results from tech giants weighed on US market cap-weighted performance late in the week. The report names no companies or figures.

risk_factors: Weakness in AI-linked tech earnings and concerns about the AI trade.
Oil supply disruptions from Houthi strikes, Hormuz tanker attacks and possible renewed US strikes on Iran.
A December Fed rate hike, with two dissents already favoring a hike.
Brazil's fiscal position (debt-to-GDP above 90%, deficit near 10% of GDP) and household indebtedness.
A growth slowdown in S&P 500 EPS from 36% in 2026 to 11% in 2027.
charts_described: Chart of the Week shows S&P 500 total return before and after peak earnings growth across five bull markets (1994-2000, 2002-2007, 2009-2015, 2016-2018, 2020-2022), with a large share of returns coming after the peak in the earlier cycles and a small share after in 2020-2022.
vol_and_positioning: VIX is up 18.85% month-to-date and 29.90% year-to-date, with a -0.15% change on the week.
US HY spread widened to 340bp from 311bp at September end, and IG spread to 90bp from 80bp. EUR HY spread rose to 385bp from 321bp.
Safe-haven demand for Treasuries continued amid concerns about the AI trade.
geopolitical: Houthi strikes on Saudi energy facilities and an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz lifted oil on Friday.
Concerns about renewed US strikes on Iran after the midterms.
Renewed diplomatic efforts earlier in the week raised hopes of easing supply disruptions.
Lula's unexpected win in Brazil's presidential election and the fiscal path that follows.

tension_points.bull_case: GSAM says 40-60% of bull-market total return has come after peak earnings growth, so investors who try to time the top risk missing upside.
tension_points.bear_case: GSAM expects S&P 500 EPS growth to fall from 36% in 2026 to 11% in 2027 and 2028, and prior cycles ended early when external forces such as trade tensions (2018) or aggressive rate hikes (2022) intervened.
tension_points.what_invalidates: An external shock that cuts the cycle short, such as aggressive rate hikes. The Fed's two dissents for a hike and expected December hike are the live version.

theme_stances.key_argument: Equities have historically kept rising after earnings growth peaks, so timing the top risks missing upside.
theme_stances.evidence: Investors risk missing out on significant upside by trying to time the top.

theme_stances.key_argument: A greater fiscal premium and currency weakness will likely keep local rates higher for longer.
theme_stances.evidence: greater fiscal premium and currency weakness will likely keep local rates higher
